arabic text: BIN TERE - NAHI DIL LAGTA MERA - CHEHRA TO DIKHLA JAA
english translation text: Akbar, I will die—come and meet Sughra. Without you my heart finds no peace; show me your face.

arabic text:
JAB BHI DEKHUN KHALI HUJRA YAAD AAYE TERI
IS SE PEHLE MERE BHAI JAAN JAYE MERI
TU MUJHE
KAB LENE AIGA
ITNA TO BATLA JAA
english translation text:
Whenever I see the empty room,
I remember you. Before my life
leaves me, my brother, tell
me at least this: when will
you come to take me?

arabic text:
MERE BHAI TUJHE ALLAH SALAMAT RAKHE
SATH TERA MERA AKBAR TA QAYAMAT RAKHE
JO KIA
TUNE MUJHSE WADA
PURA KARNE AA JA
english translation text:
Brother, may Allah keep
you safe. May our
bond remain until Judgement Day.
Come and fulfil the
promise you made to me.

arabic text:
OHO RASTE OHO BOOHE OHO MITTIYAA’N AKBAR
OHO TAANGAA’N OHO AASAA’N OHO CHITTIYAN AKBAR
VEKH LE ASI BHAIN BHIRA SAANJE
SAADA DAR VI SAANJA
english translation text:
The same roads, doors and earth, Akbar;
the same legs, hopes and letters.
See—we were brother and sister,
and even our doorway was shared.

arabic text:
KYUN NA HO TUJHSE BICHAR KAR HAAL AISA MERA
KHUWAB DEKHA HAI KAY ZAKHMI HAI KALEJA TERA
MARNE SE
PEHLE AY BHAI TU
SUGHRA KO DAFNA JAA
english translation text:
Why should my condition not be
like this after separation from you?
I dreamed that your heart
was wounded. Before I die, come
and bury Sughra, my brother.

arabic text:
MAINE US KHUAB MEIN BABA KO BHI DEKHA BHAI
UNKE KANDHE PE HAI RAN MEIN TERA LASHA BHAI
SACH NAHI
YEH BAAT MUJHE AKAR
KHUWAB MEIN HI BATLA JAA
english translation text:
In that dream, I saw Baba too.
Upon his shoulder was your body in the battlefield.
Come and tell me,
even in a dream,
that this is not true.

arabic text:
QABR PER NANA KI JAKAR YE DUA KARTI HOON
MUJHKO AKBAR SE MILA DEN JEETE JEE MARTI HOON
SAANS NA
RUK JAYE MERI BHIYYA
HOSLA DENE AA JAA
english translation text:
At Grandfather's grave, I pray:
let me meet Akbar
while still alive. My brother,
before my breath stops,
come and give me courage.

arabic text:
JAB MADINE MEIN KISI BHAI BEHAN KO DEKHA
ROKAY ZEESHAN O KARIM US GHARI SUGHRA NE KAHA
DEKH KAR
MAIN SABR KARUN KAISE
AKAR YE SAMJHA JAA
english translation text:
Whenever Sughra saw any brother and
sister in Madina, she wept and
said, O Zeeshan and Karim:
how can I remain patient? Come
and explain it to me.
